{"text":"Design a dark-themed interactive data exploration dashboard for a computational immunology dataset. Use a sidebar navigation layout with 5 pages.

Style: Dark background (#0F1117), card surfaces (#1E2130), teal/blue accent (#2E86AB), Inter font. All charts use soft glowing colors against dark backgrounds. Sidebar is fixed left, content fills the rest.

Page 1 — Dataset Overview

Row of 4 summary stat cards (total participants, modalities, timepoints, cohorts)
Bar chart: participants per study cohort
4 demographic charts in a grid: age histogram, sex donut, race bar chart, vaccine arm donut
Page 2 — HAI Titer Explorer

Dropdown to select a flu strain
Side-by-side box plots for Day 0, Day 28, Day 365
Scatter plot: Day 0 vs Day 28 titer, points colored by vaccine arm
Heatmap: all flu strains on Y-axis, color = mean Day 28 titer intensity
Page 3 — Feature Correlations

Correlation heatmap of baseline titers across strains
Scatter plot explorer with X/Y/color-by dropdowns
Grouped bar chart of top immune cell features, Day 0 vs Day 7
Page 4 — Model Performance

Dropdown or tab strip to select prediction task (Tasks 4.1–4.10)
Scatter plot: predicted vs actual values with a diagonal reference line, Spearman ρ displayed prominently
Bar chart comparing model scores across all 10 tasks
Sortable table of per-participant predicted vs actual values
Page 5 — Participant Deep Dive

Participant selector dropdown
Profile card: demographics summary
Radar or bar chart showing their antibody titers across timepoints
Small table of their predicted vs actual values per task
UX notes: Show "No data" placeholders for missing values. All charts have hover tooltips. Sidebar highlights the active page.","providerOptions":{}}
